This site is a collection of public notes and analyses related to my work at the [Nucleic Acid Observatory project](https://naobservatory.org).
Be warned: Much of it is preliminary, unfinished, and unreviewed!

An archived site with older posts is at https://naobservatory.github.io/mikes-notebook-archived.
